title: Co-Brand Cardholder Tax Credit on Crestline Companion Taxes and Fees
content:
A companion certificate of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes that was issued on a co-brand card anniversary earns a cardholder tax credit against the companion's taxes and fees. The credit follows how the certificate or pass was issued, as shown in its ground of issue, together with the miles credited to the holder's Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program by co-brand card partner accrual entries dated in the last 12 months, counted back from the handling date:

| Ground of issue of the certificate or pass | Miles from co-brand card partner accrual entries in the last 12 months | Cardholder tax credit |
|---|---|---|
| co-brand card anniversary | 60000 or more | 12 USD |
| co-brand card anniversary | 25000 to fewer than 60000 | 6 USD |
| co-brand card anniversary | fewer than 25000 | nothing |
| Summit choice benefit or promotion | any number | nothing |

**Hypothetical cases.** A card-anniversary certificate whose holder shows 62000 co-brand card miles in the last 12 months earns 12 USD. A certificate chosen as a Summit choice benefit earns nothing, whatever the card miles; so does a pass issued on a promotion.
